ko.title: 잠깐의 페이스 체크
ko.caption: 잠깐의 페이스 체크
ko.intro: 웜 그레이 셸에 버건디 이너와 짙은 브라운 타이츠를 겹쳐요. 워치는 잠깐 멈춰 확인하고 달리는 동안에는 소매를 다시 정리하세요.

en.title: A QUICK PACE CHECK
en.caption: A quick pace check
en.intro: Combine the warm grey shell with a burgundy base and dark brown tights. Pause to check your watch and settle your sleeves before running again.

de.title: A QUICK PACE CHECK
de.caption: Kurz das Tempo prüfen
de.intro: Kombiniere die warmgraue Jacke mit burgunderrotem Funktionslayer und dunkelbraunen Tights. Halte zum Blick auf die Uhr kurz an und richte die Ärmel vor dem Weiterlaufen.

copy.tipNote: The batch supplies no separate tip; the look-level howToWear (incl. its safety sentence) is the intro.

products.descriptor: warm light grey lightweight hooded running rain jacket, black full front zipper, black slanted side pockets, slim vertical silver reflective forearm strip
products.restorationNote: Shell hood zipper pockets and sleeve detail visible.

howToWear.ko: 지퍼는 가슴까지만 올려 버건디 이너가 V자로 보이게 하고, 워치를 볼 때 밀어 올린 소매는 다시 내려 두세요.
howToWear.en: Zip to the chest so the burgundy base shows in a V, and let a sleeve fall back down after pushing it up to read the watch.
howToWear.de: Nur bis zur Brust schließen, damit der burgunderrote Layer im V sichtbar wird; den Ärmel nach dem Blick auf die Uhr wieder herunterlassen.
